background: Former 15-year NBA sharpshooter (Duke; Orlando, Clippers, 76ers, Pelicans, Mavericks) who went straight from ESPN analyst and 'Mind the Game' podcast co-host with LeBron James to Lakers head coach in June 2024 with zero prior coaching experience beyond youth ball. Hired explicitly to 'think a different way' (Jeanie Buss) with a player-development and modern-offense mandate. Went 50-32 (3rd seed, lost R1 1-4 to Minnesota) in 2024-25 while absorbing the midseason Luka Doncic trade, then 53-29 in 2025-26 with a first-round win over Houston before a second-round sweep by Oklahoma City; signed an extension in Sept 2025 and became the first Lakers coach since Phil Jackson with back-to-back 50-win seasons. Known for data-driven ideas (publicly floated intentional fouling when up six), an unusually short playoff rotation, heavy zone use in 2025-26, and prickly media relations.

key_criticisms: Extremely short rotations and star overuse in the playoffs (five-man second half, Game 4 2025; visible fatigue of LeBron/Doncic)
Late-game process lapses: slow timeouts during runs, timeout process breakdown vs MIL (Jan 2026), LeBron/Doncic late-game confusion
Offense can become predictable and stagnant against deep drop coverage; pace among the slowest in the league in 2024-25
Combative with media (walked out of a 2025 playoff presser); blamed officiating after losses
Swept 0-4 by OKC in 2026 second round despite 53 wins
key_strengths: Back-to-back 50-win seasons (first Lakers coach since Phil Jackson) and a contract extension after year one
Willing to overhaul schemes midseason: switch-everything defense post-Davis trade (2025) and zone base (2026) both produced top-tier defensive stretches
Analytics-forward and intellectually curious (ChatGPT, cross-sport study, EV-based late-game ideas)
Strong relationships with Doncic ('Makes my life easy') and LeBron; players publicly back him
Clear offensive principles (spacing, handoffs, 3-point shot diet) even when execution lags
research_notes: Searches covered 2024-25 and 2025-26 well. The 2025-26 second-round result (0-4 to OKC) rests on Fadeaway World ('after getting swept by Thunder') and Space City Scoop; the Game 4 final (115-110) comes from a single aggregator. 2026-27: only the opener (127-105 win vs GSW, 2026-10-21) was verifiable; full record through 2026-11-02 and LeBron James' status (not in projected lineup; B/R headline references 'LeBron's decision' after the 2026 exit) were not confirmed because the shared web-search budget was exhausted mid-task. Conflicting 3PA-rate claims for 2024-25 (.391 early-season vs '28th in 3PA rate') are both reported. No data was found on challenge success rate, two-for-one frequency, or opponent FT rate; those scores are estimates with confidence <= 0.3. Zone usage ranking ('league-leading') is outlet framing, not tracking data.
